title: 第5章 嘻嘻我一定要活下去口牙第6章 最痛苦的死法
content_zh:
半小时后。
“所有准备都齐全了。”
王生长出一口气，只见纸张上写满了密密麻麻的字，大致内容无非是交代身后事。
“先是考虑到失败的可能性。”
王生说着，掸了掸纸上的橡皮碎屑。
“又给复活cd预留了将近24小时的时间。”
王生再看了眼一旁的钟表，现在是19点03分。
准备已经尽可能就位，能不能成，就看金手指给不给力了。
“王生啊王生，你有亡才能生，不成王便不得生。”
话音落下，他捉起了桌上，那从路边小店里买来的厨刀。
噗！
......
......
【你死了。】
“哦，谢谢你告诉我。”
能听到这种旁白，说明金手指奏效了。
【死得毫无价值，如一条丧家之犬，选择了最愚蠢，最窝囊的死法。】
不是，怎么还带骂人的？
【当然，不论你死得悲壮还是窝囊，评价并不会影响特性发动效果。】
所以只是专门来骂我的对吧？

对吧？！
【由于你被厨刀割喉而亡，你获得了「颈部切割抗性（小）」、「基础夺刀术（入门）」、「杀猪刀法（入门）」】
【你已复活。】
刷——
睁开眼，王生第一眼便是去看时间，19点03分......不，现在跳到4分了。
而且，现在桌面和身上连半点血迹都看不到。
“无时差复活？不，还要确认一下日期......”
他打开反锁房门，朝外问道：
“妈，我进屋待了多久？”
此刻的顾秀梅还在洗碗：
“啊？大概半小时吧，怎么了？”
半小时？那就是写字花去的功夫，也就是说......
“知道了，那我继续修炼了。”
说罢，王生带上门再次反锁。
“夺刀术、杀猪刀法......”
回想起脑袋内凭空多出的经验，王生暗叹神奇。
“所以死法决定了强化方向，并不会直接带来全身的增幅么？”
【全身增幅】这个异能其实就很有门道，并不是单指身体，连同精神在内也属于“全身”的一部分。
也因此，哪怕是技巧这种抽象的东西也属于强化范畴。
这也是为什么他还能领悟刀法。
content_en:
Half an hour later.
"All preparations are in place."
Wang Chang let out a breath and saw that the paper was filled with dense words, and the general content was nothing more than an explanation of what happened after his death.
“Consider the possibility of failure first.”
Wang Sheng said, dusting off the scraps of rubber on the paper.
"Nearly 24 hours have been reserved for the resurrection CD."
Wang Sheng glanced at the clock beside him again. It was now 19:03.
The preparations have been put in place as much as possible. Whether it can succeed or not depends on the strength of Goldfinger.
"Wang Sheng, Wang Sheng, you have to die to live. If you don't become a king, you can't live."
After he finished speaking, he grabbed the kitchen knife he bought from the roadside shop on the table.
puff!
...
...
【You are dead. 】
"Oh, thank you for telling me."
Being able to hear this kind of narration shows that Goldfinger worked.
[He died worthless, like a bereaved dog who chose the stupidest and most useless way to die. 】
No, why do you still use curse words?
[Of course, whether you die tragically or in vain, the evaluation will not affect the activation effect of the characteristics. 】
So you just came here specifically to scold me, right?
Right? !
[Because you were killed by a kitchen knife and your throat was cut, you gained "Neck Cut Resistance (Small)", "Basic Knife Seizing Technique (Beginner)", and "Pig Killing Knife Technique (Beginner)"]
【You have been resurrected. 】
Brush——
When he opened his eyes, Wang Sheng's first glance was to see the time, 19:03... No, it had jumped to 4 minutes now.
Moreover, not even a trace of blood can be seen on the table or body.
"Resurrection without time difference? No, we need to confirm the date..."
He opened the locked door and asked outside:
"Mom, how long have I been in the house?"
At this moment, Gu Xiumei is still washing dishes:
"Ah? About half an hour, what's wrong?"
Half an hour? That's the effort it takes to write, which means...
"I know, then I'll continue practicing."
After that, Wang Sheng closed the door and locked it again.
"The technique of seizing the sword, the technique of killing the pig..."
Recalling the extra experiences in his head, Wang Sheng secretly sighed at the wonder.
"So the way of death determines the direction of strengthening, does it not directly bring about an increase in the whole body?"
[Whole Body Amplification] This ability is actually very good. It does not only refer to the body, but also the spirit is part of the "whole body".
Therefore, even something as abstract as skill falls into the category of strengthening.
This is why he can still understand the sword technique.
